stem: Which reason BEST explains the change in the number of cars sold between 1910 and 1925?
instruction: Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: Cars became more available because of the passage of antitrust laws.

options.label: G
options.text: Cars became more affordable because of the removal of wartime price controls.

options.label: H
options.text: Cars became more affordable because of the introduction of the assembly line.

options.label: J
options.text: Cars became more available because of the removal of tariffs after a global conflict.

visual_elements: Graph titled Number of Cars Sold in the United States, 1910–1930 (millions) with a line chart showing an increase from 0.2 million cars in 1910 to around 3.8 million cars in 1925.
